sn35.82:2.3: The Pali puns _lujjati_ (“wear away”, cf. [an3.132:1.7]()) with _loka_ (“world”). This pun might seem obvious to “world-weary” folks of today, but it is the deliberate opposite of _loka_’s underlying sense. It originally referred to “light”, especially the bright lights of the heavens, hence “cosmos” and “world” generally. See note on [mn7:19.6]() for details.
